guest_bio_html: Katie Mettner writes inclusive romance and romantic suspense featuring main characters with disabilities. She became an amputee in 2011 and wrote her first novel, Sugar's Dance, while recovering. She has since published more than seventy books, including the Secure One and Secure Watch series for Harlequin Intrigue. She runs the Books Breaking Barriers initiative and a December of Disabilities reading list of books by disabled authors, and she lives in Wisconsin with her husband and her miniature dachshund service dog, Lilibet Linn.
